description: AMBIGUOUS (G5, ADR reading encoded). A javi tool call whose tool_input fails the strict validator emits nothing at all on the post-tool hook: no self-report record and no generic tool event; sentinels in the input never appear.
contract: ADR-0017 (at 2d4dcc2) decision 3 Only one record per hook call ("the hook emits only the self-report record, or nothing when the input is invalid"), Validation (same strict validator as the server)
